| Diff view | LCS line-level diff: added (green) / removed (red) / context (gray) lines with bot"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"h-side line numbers |
| Session isolation | Each session reviews only its own changes; switching ses"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"sions switches the review |
| Subagent aggregation | Changes made by subagents are aggregated into t"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"he root parent session |
| Live updates | SSE server push — the badge and list refresh instantly whe"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"n files change (zero polling) |
| Revert changes | Undo ONE specific change (later non-overlapping c"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"hanges are kept) or the WHOLE file (restore the pre-session snapshot; a file created in-session is d"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"eleted) — writes directly to disk |
| Per-turn review | Each turn's tail shows a card with THIS turn"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"'s changed files and expandable diffs (with per-op revert), distinct from the session-wide 「审查」tab |"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"
| Count badge | The 「审查」(Review) tab shows the pending file count; badge background/text colors are"},{"id":"p8s11","text":" customizable |
